run_web_research_env_evaluate: run the WebResearchEnv CLI evaluate command to measure model correctness on held-out research questions
run_web_research_env_serve: run the WebResearchEnv CLI serve command to start an OpenAI-compatible server for RL training
run_web_research_env_process: run the WebResearchEnv CLI process command to generate offline data for web research training
test_web_research_env_config: test the WebResearchEnvConfig class with reward weights for correctness, tool usage, efficiency, and diversity bonus
review_web_research_env_class: review the WebResearchEnv class that implements an RL environment for multi-step web research with multi-signal reward scoring
summarize_web_research_env_reward: summarize the compute_reward method that scores answer correctness, tool usage, efficiency, and source diversity
